q38-ctxwin-temp03-v1.verdict: REJECT, and the prediction behind it was falsified

vs_incumbent.paired: 4 gained, 12 lost, one-sided p = 0.038, significantly WORSE

q38-ctxwin-temp03-v1.the_falsified_prediction: The arm was built on the argument that failing runs show HIGHER action entropy over 500 recorded runs, so our failure mode is not too little exploration and temperature should come DOWN. That is now measured false: lowering it was significantly worse. The entropy correlation is a CONSEQUENCE of failing, not a cause. Recorded because the reasoning was explicit and wrong.
q38-ctxwin-temp03-v1.consequence: Testing the other direction (0.9) as arm H. Zero-level games nearly doubled, 5 -> 11, which is the sharpest signal in the run.
